Example of a simple notification message. This notification is valid until 2026-04-24, and will not be displayed after that date.

MeteoGate is currently experiencing issues with its cloud service provider, which is affecting the availability of some services. We’re working hard to resolve the impacts as soon as possible. As a precaution all existing apikeys have been nullified and you can request a new one from the MeteoGate portal. We’re sorry for any issues this is causing you.
